primitives.name: Version Support Indicator
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Security Policy ## Supported Versions | Version | Supported | | ------- | ------------------ | | main | :white_check_mark: | | others | :x: | ## Reporting a Vulnerability **Do not** open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.
primitives.assumptions: Only main branch receives security updates; others are deprecated.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's versioned risk scoring kernel where unsupported versions yield zero confidence.

primitives.name: Vulnerability Reporting Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: Email: security@galaxysports.ai (or the address listed in the repository owner profile) Please include: - Description of the vulnerability - Steps to reproduce - Potential impact - Any suggested fix (optional) We will acknowledge receipt within 72 hours and provide a timeline for remediation.
primitives.assumptions: All reports must be submitted via private channel; public issues are forbidden.

layer2.mapping: GSE's incident response engine uses this as input to trigger remediation workflows.
layer2.telemetry: Report submission timestamps and acknowledgment status

primitives.name: Responsible Disclosure Window
primitives.verbatim_quote: Please allow reasonable time for a fix before public disclosure.
primitives.assumptions: Fix must precede public release to prevent exploitation.

layer2.mapping: GSI's temporal risk model enforces a minimum gap between patch deployment and public disclosure.
layer2.telemetry: Patch release vs. disclosure date alignment
